# Luna Concrete Services LLC

> Concrete patios, steps & driveways based in New Braunfels, Texas. Ruben and his crew pour patios, steps, slabs, driveways and stamped walkways, show up when they say they will and do exactly what they quoted.

## Services
- Patios & pool decks: Back patios, pool decks and walkways, including yards with a steep slope.
- Steps & stairs: Multi-level entry steps and runs of yard steps poured to match the grade.
- Driveway replacement: Old driveways torn out and replaced with broom-finished concrete and clean joints.
- Slabs & foundations: Shed, building and foundation slabs, formed with rebar and vapor barrier.
- Stamped walkways: Stone-pattern paths through gardens, with colored inlays when you want one.
- Flatwork & custom jobs: Side-yard pads, utility pads and one-off work like fire pits, docks and drains.

## About
Luna Concrete Services LLC is a New Braunfels concrete contractor based on Northaven Trail and run by Ruben. Ruben gives the quote, keeps customers posted through the job and works alongside his crew. Customers hire Luna for back patios on steep lots, multi-level entry steps, shed and building slabs, driveway replacements and stamped stone-pattern walkways, one with a Texas flag inlay. One customer has used Ruben for three jobs and another for two, and several say they will call him again.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you pour a patio on a sloped yard?
  A: Yes. One customer’s back yard had a severe incline that needed many steps, and the finished patio came out on time.
- Q: Do you do stamped or decorative concrete?
  A: Yes. Luna pours stamped stone-pattern walkways, including one with a colored Texas flag inlay.
- Q: Can you pour a shed or building slab?
  A: Yes. Slabs are formed with rebar and a vapor barrier before the pour.
- Q: What if I need to change my pour date?
  A: Ruben works with you. One customer moved the date and the job still finished faster than predicted.
- Q: Where are you based?
  A: 4020 Northaven Trail in New Braunfels, working in Canyon Lake, Seguin, San Marcos, Garden Ridge and Schertz.
